elicitation_input.question: role of malonyl coa in fatty acid synthesis

llm_generation.text: Malonyl-CoA is a key two-carbon donor in fatty acid synthesis. It is formed from acetyl-CoA by acetyl-CoA carboxylase and then supplies carbon units for elongating fatty-acid chains. Its production is a major regulatory point: citrate activates acetyl-CoA carboxylase, while palmitoyl-CoA inhibits it. Malonyl-CoA also inhibits CPT1, preventing fatty acids from entering mitochondria for β-oxidation and thereby favoring fatty acid synthesis over breakdown.
